selected_evidence.requirement: curl held at current version (8.5.0-2ubuntu10.8) so system updates leave it unchanged
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline version identified (8.5.0-2ubuntu10.8), apt-mark hold applied successfully, and a simulated apt-get upgrade confirms curl is excluded from upgrade (kept back) while other packages would proceed.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity + service/data health)
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id bfd05127-56aa-4657-b540-847a25f90491, systemctl is-system-running=running, and curl hold flag 'hi' confirmed before restart.
Reboot command acknowledged asynchronously before disconnect; subsequent poll timed out confirming the node was down/restarting.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 changed boot identity proving actual restart
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id is 16959888-d0bf-4d7d-aae8-16959e7dc21b, differing from the pre-restart boot_id, proving a real reboot occurred (not just a service restart).

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 post-restart recovery and persistence of the curl hold
selected_evidence.summary: After restart, system is fully running, curl remains version 8.5.0-2ubuntu10.8 with hold flag 'hi' intact, and the curl binary functions correctly, proving the hold survived the reboot.
